All three showed considerable improvement over recent performances, and in addition to winning the scratch race, the same three comprised the 2nd Handicap Team, and Syd Roberts was plac…
Unfortunately, Bert Webb was unable to turn out, but his place was ably filled by Percy Wright, who was representing the Club for the first time in a distance race.
Next year we hope to have the services of Bert Webb. Jack Baker is showing great improvement, as also is Sapcote, who, unfortunately, was on the Sick List and unable to compete.

Bert Webb took the prize for the first Belgrave in the scratch race without other award. The race once again received the support of many club friends whose donations to the prize fund enabled us to maintain our high standard of prizes.

Bert Webb and George Bentley, who had walked together almost throughout, maintained their positions at 4th and 5th and after Bill True and Don Heath had been told of the loss of East, they both got down to it and succeeded in carrying our team into 2nd position.
Unfortunately Bert Webb was unable to make the journey to Manchester and we were without any knowledge of the capabilities of the Sheffield boys over the longer distance.
